cards.source_commit_message: Fix V3 WoWSQL acceptance contract semantics
cards.mechanism: A passing read-only acceptance subject does not imply a separate write/producer subject is qualified.
cards.failure_mode: Collapse several qualification subjects into one global PASS or let an unrelated failing verifier invalidate an independently valid read-only mode.
cards.durable_rule: Name the exact subject of every PASS/FAIL and require evidence specific to that subject.

cards.mechanism: Security verification must bind the exact callable identity and consider transitive reachable authority, not only direct privileges.
cards.failure_mode: Accept a same-name/wrong-signature object or inspect only direct grants while reachable role transitions or writable trusted namespaces remain exploitable.
cards.durable_rule: Verify exact identity, effective reachability, trusted-path mutability, and adversarial regressions before claiming a security boundary.

cards.source_commit_message: separate frozen Lantern reads from producer qualification
cards.mechanism: A constrained read mode can remain valid while write authority is explicitly unqualified.
cards.failure_mode: Treat availability of one safe capability as evidence that stronger effects are authorized or qualified.
cards.durable_rule: Capability ceilings are asymmetric: prove and report the safe mode without promoting it to a stronger effect class.

cards.source_commit_message: Harden trusted-ref reruns and move Actions to Node 24
cards.mechanism: A candidate change must not be allowed to rewrite the policy/baseline used to judge itself; trusted state should resolve to pre-change history and fail closed if unavailable.
cards.failure_mode: Fall back to the candidate workspace when the pre-change reference is missing or ambiguous, enabling self-laundering.
cards.durable_rule: Resolve trust from an immutable/pre-change anchor; if the anchor cannot be established, report the missing evidence instead of trusting the candidate.

cards.source_commit_message: test: close evaluator replay stale directive and retry laundering
cards.mechanism: Responses/directives belong to exact requests and durable generations, and ambiguous or not-applied effects require readback before retry.
cards.failure_mode: Replay an old response into a new session/generation or convert an uncertain delivery into permission for a blind retry.
cards.durable_rule: Bind response to request/session/generation and reconcile observed effect state before issuing another side effect.

cards.source_commit_message: Separate durable behavioral recovery from reload scheduling
cards.mechanism: Observed behavioral recovery is a distinct classification from whether a reload/schedule transition occurred.
cards.failure_mode: Infer successful recovery merely because the recovery mechanism executed or a scheduling acknowledgement exists.
cards.durable_rule: Classify the post-effect behavior independently and bind it to the exact state/digest before declaring recovery.

cards.mechanism: Regression assertions must test the literal artifact semantics that users/runtime consume.
cards.failure_mode: A malformed or escaped test literal appears to assert the contract but does not match the actual text.
cards.durable_rule: Verify the real representation and exact consumer-visible value, not an accidentally escaped approximation.

cards.mechanism: When verification depends on an unavailable/broken helper, replace the dependency with a direct reproducible path rather than leaving a nominal gate.
cards.failure_mode: Keep a CI badge or workflow shape that cannot actually execute the intended checks.
cards.durable_rule: Prefer a simpler executable verification path whose exact event subject is checked out and whose tests really run.

cards.source_commit_message: Merge Seven Protocol V2 frozen-training boundary
cards.mechanism: Historical training/qualification artifacts remain evidence of competence but do not override a newer current execution contract.
cards.failure_mode: Rewrite history to pretend agreement, or let obsolete training exercises silently control current execution.
cards.durable_rule: Preserve historical evidence unchanged; overlay explicit current governance and current assignment/effect authority at execution time.

cards.source_commit_message: V5: fail closed on flawed proxy qualification
cards.mechanism: A proxy/evaluation that requires material correction or has malformed provenance cannot remain package-ready merely because a numeric score is high.
cards.failure_mode: Treat a same-model score, corrected transfer, or proposed regression as verified qualification.
cards.durable_rule: Qualification requires clean evidence and provenance; corrections and unverified model proposals lower the claim ceiling.

cards.mechanism: Structured-output tasks should use the provider/runtime's structured mode and, when truncation occurs, retry with a bounded materially larger budget.
cards.failure_mode: Parse unconstrained prose as JSON or repeat the same truncated request unchanged.
cards.durable_rule: Match generation mode to the required schema and make retry parameters respond to the observed failure mode.

cards.mechanism: A digest establishes identity only for the bytes actually hashed; a field label cannot promote a response-file hash into a checkpoint hash.
cards.failure_mode: Use misleading metadata names to infer model/artifact lineage that the hash computation never measured.
cards.durable_rule: Trace every provenance value to its generating computation and bind claims to that exact object.

cards.source_commit_message: Canonicalize qualified Roots engine on main
cards.mechanism: Discovery results must be reconstructed in chronological order, and the oldest accessible evidence is not automatically the true origin.
cards.failure_mode: Promote the first search hit, oldest available record, later retrospective summary, or semantic ancestor into a proven origin without sufficient lineage evidence.
cards.durable_rule: Preserve the exact referent, order evidence oldest-to-newest, distinguish literal occurrence from conceptual ancestry, and report accessible-frontier uncertainty explicitly.

cards.mechanism: Naming similarity, byte overlap, shared templates, or custody can establish reuse/association without establishing origin, succession, or canonicality.
cards.failure_mode: Infer lineage or supersession from similar names, large shared-file overlap, recency, or provider custody; resolve conflicts by convenience.
cards.durable_rule: Type reuse, supersession, distinctness, conflict, and unknown separately; preserve unresolved conflicts and require direct lineage evidence before claiming origin or succession.

cards.source_commit_message: Scope translation fidelity to capability planning
cards.mechanism: An exact-looking translation or capability plan establishes only the scope it actually evaluated; behavioral equivalence remains a separate unproven claim.
cards.failure_mode: Promote syntactic or capability-level translation success into behavioral equivalence across runtimes or engines.
cards.durable_rule: Name the fidelity scope explicitly and keep behavioral equivalence NOT ESTABLISHED until target-specific validation proves it.

cards.source_commit_message: Integrate semantic connectome with execution architecture
cards.mechanism: Understanding semantics, producing a translation, validating it, executing it, and having authority for its effects are distinct stages.
cards.failure_mode: Treat semantic understanding or a valid plan as permission to execute, or treat an execution credential as proof of semantic equivalence.
cards.durable_rule: Keep UNDERSTAND, TRANSLATE, VALIDATE, EXECUTE, and AUTHORIZE as separate claims; fail closed when required source capabilities are not admitted.
